Thank you for taking the time to write this — and sorry for the automated reply.

**Finder does not accept external code contributions**, so this pull request is
being closed unreviewed. This is not a judgement on the change you made.
Copyright in the codebase is deliberately kept undivided, which is what lets us
state where the software came from without qualification. Merging outside code
would end that permanently, and it cannot be undone one contribution at a time.

**What is welcome, and is read:**

- **Bug reports and feature requests** — please open an issue describing the
  problem or the need. A description of a problem is a fact we can act on, and
  it is the part we actually want.
- **Security vulnerabilities** — please do *not* use a public issue. Report them
  through the Security tab, or by email as described in
  [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/DoCoNEXT/doconext_finder/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

You remain free to fork Finder and modify it for your own purposes under the
AGPL. [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/DoCoNEXT/doconext_finder/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
has the reasoning in full.
